params.name: archived
params.description:
Filter using the boolean archived flag. DebitReasons can be archived if they are obsolete.
* TRUE includes DebitReasons that have been archived.
* FALSE excludes archived DebitReasons.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of the Debit Reason entities created for your Organization. You can filter the list returned for the call by Debit Reason ID, Debit Reason short code, or by Archive status.
